paragraphs: Week 5 (Oct 9 – 13, Lectures 9 and 10) Teaching and Learning

4.4 Concavity and curve sketching: concavity and second derivatives; points of inflection; second derivative test; graph sketching (just need to present the general idea --- students can use graphing software/apps/websites in practice).

4.4 Concavity (extended): Here is useful (and intuitive) fact not directly listed in the book: a concave down curve has its secant line lying below and tangent lines lying above, and a concave up curve has its secant line lying above and tangent lines lying below. (Please tell the students this fact --- its proof is a nice application of the mean value theorem, which can be found in my note named “1001lec09 2002” --- the proof is optional, so feel free to skip.)
4.6 Newton’s method: the method and one (or more) example.
it is OK to shuffle the contents above around in an order you prefer and feel free to add in your own stuff, so long as the non-optional topics are all covered.
Feel free to go faster but aim not to be slower.
